data: La folle aventure de trois copines invitées au mariage de leur meilleure amie au Brésil. A peine arrivées à Rio, elles tuent accidentellement un jeune homme trop insistant. Dès lors, tout s’emballe..! (The crazy adventure of three gal pals invited to their best friend's wedding in Brazil. Shortly after arriving in Rio, they accidentally kill a young man who got too pushy. From then on, things get fast and furious...)

The crazy adventure of three gal pals invited to their best friend's wedding in Brazil. Shortly after arriving in Rio, they accidentally kill a young man who got too pushy. From then on, things get fast and furious...
